changelog:
v2.10.1 - Screen Recorder: fixes clips saving with 0:00 duration.

- Recorder is now stopped BEFORE the capture display is torn down, with a short settle so the MP4 index is written (clips show real duration and seek correctly).
- Broken/too-short clips are no longer kept as junk files.
- Unreadable duration shows ? instead of a fake 0:00.
